subject.name_or_desc: The querent herself, who has lost one diamond earring in her own flat

context.question: Where is my diamond earring, and will it be recovered?
context.asked_at: Date not stated in the published case
context.setting: The earring is missing somewhere in the querent's flat; diligent searching of the kitchen and bathroom has not found it.

attachments.key_positions: Sun, ruler of the 2nd house (the earring's significator), in the 11th house; its antiscion at 25°42' Cancer conjunct the Ascendant; Moon in Pisces, besieged by Mars and Saturn, applying by sextile to Mercury; Venus (natural significator of jewellery) combust; lord of the Ascendant angular

provenance.work: Sharon Knight, 'Horary astrology: Where is my Diamond Earring?', Skyscript
